clue.text: Transport vehicles for people who teach theatre?

parts.note: the stage is the theatre as a profession or art form
coaches are trainers or tutors who teach

explanation.surface: A whimsical query about what sort of vehicle drama tutors would travel in.
explanation.walkthrough: The pieces come in reverse clue order: STAGE (theatre) then COACHES (people who teach).
explanation.definitionFit: Stagecoaches were horse-drawn carriages that carried passengers on regular routes.

clue.text: Perhaps the Med left worker a protective coat

parts.note: the Mediterranean is an example of a sea
a worker ant is the crossword's usual worker

explanation.surface: Someone from the Mediterranean region left a labourer with a coat of something protective.
explanation.definitionFit: A sealant is a substance applied as a coating to make a surface watertight or protected.

clue.text: A night in Paris covered by city pension

indicators.note: one piece is wrapped round, covering, the other

parts.note: NY is the abbreviation for New York City
nuit is French for night

explanation.surface: An evening in the French capital is paid for by a city retirement income.
explanation.definitionFit: An annuity is a yearly payment, often bought to provide a retirement pension.

clue.text: Wild rose in elegant setting

indicators.note: setting the letters means arranging them anew, as in setting type

explanation.surface: A wild flower displayed in a stylish arrangement.
explanation.walkthrough: 'setting' rearranges the letters of IN ELEGANT.
explanation.definitionFit: Eglantine is another name for the sweetbriar, a wild rose of hedgerows.

clue.text: Ring roads surround area for such houses in Kent

indicators.note: the first pieces go round the next one, enclosing it

parts.note: a ring is round like the letter O
ST is the abbreviation for street, so STS is roads

explanation.surface: Ring roads encircling a district of distinctive Kentish buildings.
explanation.walkthrough: Kent, a county in south-east England, is famous for oast houses, conical-roofed kilns used to dry hops for brewing.
explanation.definitionFit: Oasts are the hop-drying kilns that give oast houses their name, typical of the Kent landscape.

clue.text: Complaining of high pitched noise under vehicle

indicators.note: in a down clue this piece sits beneath the other, so comes after it

parts.note: a car is a vehicle
a ping is a short high-pitched ringing sound

explanation.surface: Grumbling about a shrill noise coming from underneath the car.
explanation.definitionFit: Carping means finding fault or grumbling pettily, a synonym for complaining.

clue.text: Country dancing is at one

indicators.note: dancing letters move about into a new order

explanation.surface: A nation whose people are united when they dance together.
explanation.definitionFit: Estonia is a Baltic country in northern Europe.

clue.text: Crazy girl going cool over musician boyfriend?

definitions.text: girl going cool over musician boyfriend?
definitions.meaning: read literally, a girl who goes off (cools towards) the rock musician she dates

explanation.surface: A young woman cooling on her rock-star boyfriend is called mad.
explanation.definitionFit: The idiom means mad or insane, a colloquial synonym for crazy.

clue.text: Whisky perhaps diluted gets you easily riled

parts.note: a short is a small measure of spirits, such as whisky
tempered means moderated or toned down

explanation.surface: Watered-down whisky makes a drinker cross.
explanation.definitionFit: Short-tempered describes someone quick to anger, so easily irritated.

clue.text: Short trousers? Soft soap

indicators.note: cutting short means dropping the final letter of the word

parts.note: ... are trousers made of ... cloth

explanation.surface: A two-part note: brief trousers, and gentle soap.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Short' looks like it describes the trousers, but it docks the last letter from FLANNELS.
explanation.definitionFit: Flannel is flattering or evasive talk, as is soft soap, both meaning smooth persuasion.

clue.text: Withdraw from competition through injury

definitions.meaning: to pull out of an event before it starts
a slight wound such as a graze

explanation.surface: An athlete pulls out of a contest after getting hurt.
explanation.definitionFit: To scratch is to withdraw an entrant; a scratch is also a minor wound.

clue.text: Allotment next to old address

parts.note: a ration is an allotted share

explanation.surface: A gardening plot beside a former place of residence.
explanation.definitionFit: An oration is a formal speech, and address can mean a speech delivered to an audience.

clue.text: One does wrong pinching money from bowler

indicators.note: pinching grips the next piece, holding it inside

parts.note: a sinner is one who does wrong
P stands for penny, a coin

explanation.surface: A wrongdoer stealing cash from a cricketer.
explanation.walkthrough: In cricket, a spinner is a bowler who makes the ball turn; 'bowler' is not the hat.
explanation.definitionFit: A spinner is a type of cricket bowler who spins the ball.

clue.text: Admission by one on guard duty losing head

indicators.note: the word loses its first letter

parts.note: a sentry stands guard

explanation.surface: A guard who has been decapitated lets someone in.
explanation.definitionFit: Entry means admission, the right or act of going in.

clue.text: Single bursary (post 2001) for one coming in to settle

indicators.note: post means after, so this piece follows the others

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
MMI is 2001 in Roman numerals
a grant is a sum awarded for study

explanation.surface: A one-off student grant from this century for a newcomer settling in.
explanation.definitionFit: An immigrant is someone who comes to live permanently in a foreign country.

clue.text: Temporary move by brand

parts.note: a make is a brand of product
to shift is to move

explanation.surface: A stop-gap relocation organised by a company.
explanation.definitionFit: Makeshift means improvised as a temporary substitute.

clue.text: Drinks finally appear during serving of upmarket meat dish

indicators.note: this letter shows up in the middle of the other letters
a serving rearranges the word, served up anew
the final letter of the word is taken

explanation.surface: Drinks arrive at last while a posh steak dinner is being served.
explanation.walkthrough: 'finally' gives S, the last letter of Drinks; 'serving of' rearranges UPMARKET, and 'appear during' puts S inside it.
explanation.definitionFit: Rump steak is a cut of beef from the hindquarters, served as a meat dish.

clue.text: A mark covered by mother's cosmetic

indicators.note: one piece is wrapped round by the others

parts.note: ma is mother
a scar is a mark left on the skin

explanation.surface: A blemish hidden under a mother's make-up.
explanation.definitionFit: Mascara is a cosmetic used to darken eyelashes.

clue.text: The master initially served smoked herring

indicators.note: only the first letter of the word is taken

parts.note: a kipper is a smoked herring

explanation.surface: The ship's captain was first given smoked fish.
explanation.definitionFit: A skipper is the master or captain of a ship.

clue.text: Rumours of depression arrive from such a doctor

indicators.note: rumours are things heard, so the words are said aloud

parts.note: low means a depression; come means arrive

explanation.surface: Hearsay of gloominess arriving from a stand-in doctor.
explanation.definitionFit: A locum is a doctor who stands in temporarily for another.

clue.text: Student left job that pays

parts.note: an earner is a source of income

explanation.surface: A pupil quit a paid post.
explanation.definitionFit: A learner is someone studying, a synonym for student.

clue.text: One might aspire to go after social type of plant

definitions.text: One might aspire to go after social
definitions.meaning: a social ... is someone who aspires to higher status
a plant that grows up supports, such as ivy

explanation.surface: An ambitious person compared to a creeping plant.
explanation.definitionFit: A climber is both a plant that climbs and an ambitious person, as in social climber.

clue.text: About to get a bite, fishing

parts.note: C stands for circa, about
a sting is a bite from an insect

explanation.surface: An angler waiting to get a nibble on the line.
explanation.definitionFit: Casting is the act of throwing out a fishing line.

clue.text: Diver born into mainly environmentally-friendly surroundings

indicators.note: this piece goes inside the other
mainly means most of the word, losing the last letter

parts.note: green means environmentally friendly

explanation.surface: A diver born into an eco-conscious setting.
explanation.walkthrough: GREE (GREEN cut short by 'mainly') surrounds B.
explanation.definitionFit: The grebe is a water bird that dives for its food.

clue.text: Land by water for treating disease

indicators.note: treating works the letters over into a new form

explanation.surface: Going to the coast as a cure for illness.
explanation.definitionFit: The seaside is the land beside the sea.

clue.text: Object lesson that was once sufficient

parts.note: ex means former
ample means enough

explanation.surface: A teaching example that used to be adequate.
explanation.definitionFit: An example can serve as a model or object lesson.

clue.text: Mean gas might be on one? — good

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one
a noble gas, such as neon

explanation.surface: Someone stingy wonders whether gas is on them.
explanation.definitionFit: Ignoble means base or dishonourable, a sense of mean.

clue.text: Hear terror is spreading — could one replace locks?

indicators.note: spreading scatters the letters into a new order

explanation.surface: Panic spreads about a product to restore lost hair.
explanation.walkthrough: 'spreading' rearranges HEAR TERROR IS; 'locks' is hair, not door locks.
explanation.definitionFit: A hair restorer is a treatment claimed to regrow hair, replacing lost locks.
